extensionDescription.message: Send browser downloads to the local LightDl desktop app for faster, resumable downloading.

summary.message: Downloads are sent to LightDl on this computer through Native Messaging.

requireHost.message: Register the browser host in LightDl.

fallback.message: Your browser resumes the original download if capture fails or is declined.

privacy.message: Download URLs and required cookies are used only for local downloads, never sent to developer servers.
